fields.purpose: Deliver an accepted iterator payload to the command write callback as one complete command.
fields.input_preconditions: Empty input returns zero; input exceeding 4096 bytes is rejected before copying or callback invocation.
fields.changed_and_preserved_state: Advance file position by the accepted write count; rewind unaccepted copied bytes through the iterator contract.
fields.effects_and_callback_boundary: Collect the entire accepted payload before invoking the write callback once, even when copying requires multiple successful short copies.
fields.errors_and_partial_completion: Copy errors or zero progress trigger rewind of prior copied bytes before returning an error; rewind can itself fail. Callback errors trigger rewind of the complete count. This does not undo arbitrary callback side effects.
fields.execution_context: The body allocates a command buffer and invokes caller-dependent iterator and write operations; their scheduling and memory-access requirements must be supplied separately.
fields.delegation: Dispatch the assembled command through self.write; the iterator wrapper owns its copy/rewind accounting contract.

fields.purpose: Provide the device-tree backend's structural and property interpretation capabilities.
fields.owned_capabilities: Own structural access, property decoding, node status and device-tree address translation.
fields.non_goals: Do not own kernel registration, IRQ mapping, MMIO mapping or DMA allocation; controller-specific register roles and interrupt encodings belong to drivers.
fields.invariants_and_resources: Interpret firmware data separately from OS resource acquisition; boot DTB ownership and initialization remain in host integration until migrated.
fields.dependency_direction: Keep OS resource acquisition in existing provider contracts rather than importing those responsibilities into the device-tree library.
fields.delegation_interfaces: The historical design names FdtNode interpretation methods and the backend-neutral FwNodeOps contract; do not infer a CPU-specific interface from later changes.
fields.configuration: The design describes optional alloc for address collection and an optional fwnode backend feature; the complete build feature closure has not been validated here.
fields.exceptions: OF/IRQ/PCI and boot helpers outside the scoped migration remain tracked debt; their existence is not blanket approval for new interpretation duplication.
